title: Leyendecker's "First Long Suit"
content: One of the original paintings for sale in today'sHeritage Auction of American artisFirst Long Suitby J.C. Leyendecker.The mother sits misty-eyed as a tailor sizes up a young man for his first long suit. Leyendecker took great care with the textures of the fabric and the surfaces for the furniture.The magazine cover came out in September, 1937, at the height of Leyendecker's prowess as a painter.Heritage Auction of American artis today, May 10.The auctionincludes J.C. Leyendecker, Maurice Sendak, N.C. Wyeth, Norman Rockwell, and Maynard Dixon.Thanks, Meagan McMillan
